Subject: Access controls & residency evidence for SIG review

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — EuroHealth is progressing toward a SIG review and we need to collect a few targeted artifacts and clarifications around access controls before the kickoff. Can you help with the following by EOD Friday (our time)?

- SAML / SSO: example assertion (with attributes redacted) and the SAML IdP metadata you publish to customers
- SCIM: recent delta sync export (sample of user provisioning events, CSV or logs) covering the last 30 days
- RBAC: a simple role-to-permissions matrix for the account-level roles we discussed (Admin, Operator, ReadOnly, Billing) and notes on service accounts
- Least privilege: brief narrative describing how you approach role minimization and periodic attestation cadence
- Data residency: confirmation of which controls/logs you provide for EU-hosted tenants and where audit logs are stored

We attached the SIG questionnaire extract with the specific controls rows. If some items require a short workback (e.g., extracting SCIM deltas), please share an ETA and any drive links to artifacts.

Also copy procurement for cataloging.

Thanks,
Marie

Laura / Priyom — quick status and proposed deliverables.

1) SAML / SSO
- Deliverable: SAML assertion samples (attribute values redacted) + IdP metadata XML we publish to customers.
- Note: sample assertion will include Subject, NameIDFormat, Issuer, and example attribute statements with placeholders. No PII. Ready by end of day Friday PST.

2) SCIM
- Deliverable: SCIM delta export (CSV) with user add/update/delete events for a representative test tenant covering 30 days. We'll include a short readme describing field mapping and timestamp timezone.
- Workback: For EU-hosted tenant logs we need to pull from the EU provisioning cluster — estimate 1 business day to sanitize and package. ETA: Monday 20 July EOD CET if they require EU-resident raw logs; representative sample we can provide Friday.

3) RBAC + least-privilege narrative
- Deliverable: rbac-role-matrix.csv (role -> permissions) and a 1-page narrative describing attestation cadence (quarterly owner attestations via the Console) and service-account governance. Ready Friday.

4) Data residency / audit logs
- Deliverable: short statement mapping EU deployment options (region tags), where audit logs are stored (customer-managed S3 for Private / EU-hosted cluster retention policies for Hosted), and retention/TTL for the audit index. We'll attach a link to the EU logs Playbook.
- Note: If EuroHealth needs raw audit exports (full event sets) from EU clusters, that requires SOC/Legal approval and a signed DPA addendum; provide timeline and contact if they want that.

I'll prepare the asset bundle and upload to the drive folder Laura mentioned. Priyom — can you confirm the sample SCIM CSV columns and also run a quick redaction pass for any email fields that look production (we should normalize to example.net)?

Thanks,
Rishi
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Access controls & residency evidence for SIG review -- artifacts attached

Marie / team — attaching the bundle we discussed. Summary below and links.

What we attached:
- SAML-assertion-samples.txt: two redacted assertion examples (login and attribute-release) and our published IdP metadata (xml snippet).
- SCIM-sync-samples-2026-06.zip: representative delta CSV (adds/updates/deletes) with header readme. Note: the full EU-resident export requires a DPA addendum; representative sample only included here.
- rbac-role-matrix.csv: simple mapping for Admin, Operator, ReadOnly, Billing and separate section on service accounts and scoped API keys.
- SIG-crosswalk.docx: a short mapping document that ties each attachment to the SIG/CAIQ control rows you provided.

Key notes / answers to your bullets:
- SSO/SAML: We publish IdP metadata at https://accounts.redwoodinference.com/saml/metadata.xml and use standard SAML 2.0 assertions. Attributes released are scoped per-customer via per-tenant attribute filters; samples attached.
- SCIM: The provisioning pipeline writes deltas to cluster-local logs; for hosted EU tenants we store sanitized deltas for 90 days by default. We can provide longer retention via Dedicated/Private options.
- RBAC / Least privilege: Role minimization is enforced via Console-driven owner attestations on a quarterly cadence. Service accounts are strongly-scoped; we rotate API keys on a 90-day schedule and log all service-account actions with an elevated-access tag.
- Data residency: For EU-hosted tenants, audit indexes and provisioning logs remain in the EU cluster. For Private deployments customers can configure customer-managed object storage. Full raw event exports from EU clusters require a signed DPA addendum and a small compliance fee (we can share the legal contact if needed).

Drive (read-only) link to bundle: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cEHP-audit-evidence
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-98765 (we've attached the bundle to the deal record).

If you'd like, we can arrange a 30-minute session next week to walk through the extracts and run a quick demo of the attestation workflow.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Solutions (Sales Engineering)
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
+1 (650) 555-0199
